Pricing sources

Zapier pricing page (last verified 2026-09-20, listed in USD)A task is a successfully completed action. Triggers, polling, Formatter, Paths and Tables do not count.Pay-per-task overage is 2.5x the base rate on monthly plans and 1.25x on annual plans, capped at 3x the plan's task allowance.Only entry tiers were read from the page. Larger tiers exist and are not modeled.
A task is a successfully completed action. Triggers, polling, Formatter, Paths and Tables do not count.
Pay-per-task overage is 2.5x the base rate on monthly plans and 1.25x on annual plans, capped at 3x the plan's task allowance.
Only entry tiers were read from the page. Larger tiers exist and are not modeled.

Make pricing page (last verified 2026-09-20, listed in USD)Each module action in a scenario uses one credit. Routers and error-handler modules do not.When credits run out, scenarios stop until credits are added. Extra credits come in 1,000 or 10,000 bundles, priced at checkout and not modeled here.The page says annual billing saves 15% or more but shows no exact annual price in the text we read, so monthly prices are used.Core, Pro and Teams list the same 10,000 credits at entry volume. Higher tiers exist and are not modeled.
Each module action in a scenario uses one credit. Routers and error-handler modules do not.
When credits run out, scenarios stop until credits are added. Extra credits come in 1,000 or 10,000 bundles, priced at checkout and not modeled here.
The page says annual billing saves 15% or more but shows no exact annual price in the text we read, so monthly prices are used.
Core, Pro and Teams list the same 10,000 credits at entry volume. Higher tiers exist and are not modeled.

n8n pricing page (last verified 2026-09-20, listed in EUR)An execution is one run of a whole workflow, whatever the number of steps.Cloud prices are the annual-billed monthly figures. The page text does not list monthly-billed rates.Self-hosted Community Edition is free to license. Business and Enterprise licences are priced through sales and are not modeled.
An execution is one run of a whole workflow, whatever the number of steps.
Cloud prices are the annual-billed monthly figures. The page text does not list monthly-billed rates.
Self-hosted Community Edition is free to license. Business and Enterprise licences are priced through sales and are not modeled.
